resulting-before-cause.mistakeNote: Puts 'The resulting reactions' before the reactions it points back to.

cause-first-forced.mistakeNote: Forces cause-first order on a narrative that signals result first.

article-by-spelling.mistakeNote: Picks 'a' for 'unused' by spelling instead of its vowel sound.

preposition-pattern.mistakeNote: Borrows 'on' from 'focused on' instead of the partner 'interested in'.

mixed-list-form.mistakeNote: Breaks an -ing list with a to-plus-verb item.

synonym-after-far-from.mistakeNote: Repeats the calm quality after 'Far from being' instead of its opposite.

one-blank-only.mistakeNote: Second blank fits but the first blank contradicts 'replace the entire structure'.

wrong-partner.mistakeNote: Uses a general action verb instead of the usual partner 'make a decision'.

idiom-by-parts.mistakeNote: Picks an eye idiom that means ignore when the sentence needs watch.

present-for-past.mistakeNote: Uses a present form after the past clue 'Last Tuesday'.

had-for-unfinished.mistakeNote: Treats an interrupted, half-done action as finished.

wrong-job.mistakeNote: Puts an adjective after an action verb where an adverb is needed.

plural-subject-s.mistakeNote: Gives a singular verb to the plural subject 'assistants'.

verb-pattern.mistakeNote: Uses an -ing form after 'want', which takes 'to' plus the base verb.

wrong-day.wrongChoice: Before the counter closes on Monday
wrong-day.mistakeNote: Takes the day from the closure line instead of the line that names the collection day.

adding-a-guess.wrongChoice: She found that the dispatch log contained an error.
adding-a-guess.mistakeNote: Treats checking as finding an error that the text never reports.

widening-the-claim.wrongChoice: Replace all online services with telephone calls.
widening-the-claim.mistakeNote: Turns an added option into a full replacement.

claim-not-in-text.wrongChoice: The branch has ended all waiting at the counter.
claim-not-in-text.mistakeNote: Picks a claim that sounds like the point but is not stated in the text.

reference-before-source.mistakeNote: Opens with a sentence that says 'that audit' before the audit is introduced.
Puts 'these structural innovations' before the sentence that introduces them.

the-noun-link.mistakeNote: Places the findings with 'The study' before the sentence that introduces the study.

first-before-next.mistakeNote: Puts the step marked 'Next' before the step marked 'First'.

prerequisite-step.mistakeNote: Removes the cover before the power is isolated.

contrast-before-claim.mistakeNote: Opens with 'However' before the methods it contrasts are introduced.

example-before-idea.mistakeNote: Opens with 'For example' before the general statement it illustrates.
